common.demoBanner: Demonstration only. Hospitals, doctors and patients here are not real.

auth.identifierHint: A 10-digit Indian mobile number, or an email address.
auth.demoHint: Demo accounts are listed in the project README.
auth.caregiverNote: A caregiver can act for a patient only after that patient approves.
auth.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, mixing letters with numbers or symbols.
auth.syntheticOnly: This is a demonstration. Please do not enter real health information.

home.offerWaiting: A time has opened up from the waiting list.
home.pendingRequests: Caregiver requests waiting for your decision: {{count}}.

book.title: Book an appointment
book.orDescribe: Or describe it in your own words
book.iKnowSpecialty: I know which kind of doctor I need
book.suggestionNote: This is a suggestion for which kind of doctor to see. It is not a diagnosis.
book.unreviewed: Demonstration content. Not yet reviewed by a clinician.
book.noMatch: We could not match that to a department. Please choose one.
book.emergency: If this may be an emergency, call 112 or 108 now, or go to the nearest emergency department. This app cannot help in an emergency.
book.noDoctors: No doctors found for this choice.
book.noSlots: No free times in the next two weeks.

wait.title: Waiting list
wait.joined: You are on the waiting list. If a time opens, you will see an offer here in the app.
wait.offerExpires: This offer is held for you until {{when}}.

assistant.title: Booking assistant
assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.guidedMode: The AI service is not connected, so the assistant is working in guided mode: it follows fixed questions and you can answer with the buttons or by typing.
assistant.voiceOff: Voice is not set up on this installation. Please use the buttons or type.
assistant.voiceOutFailed: The reply could not be read aloud. It is shown above.
assistant.voiceTranscriptReady: Voice heard. Review the text below, then send it.
assistant.disclaimer: The assistant helps with booking only. It does not give medical advice. In an emergency call 112 or 108.

voice.MIC_DENIED: The microphone is blocked. Allow it in your browser settings, or type instead.
voice.NO_SPEECH: I could not hear that. Please try again, or type instead.
voice.UNAVAILABLE: Voice is unavailable right now. Please type instead.
voice.FAILED: Voice did not work this time. Please try again, or type instead.

intake.note: Your answers go to the doctor for this appointment. They are your own words, not a medical record.
intake.none: No answers have been given yet.

summary.title: Summary of your answers
summary.explain: An AI model can turn your answers into a short summary for the doctor. You read it first, and it is shared only if you approve. Your saved answers are sent to the AI provider for this; do not include real personal details in this demonstration.
summary.share: This is correct. Share with the doctor
summary.shared: You have shared this summary with the doctor.
summary.notShared: Not shared yet. Only you can see this until you approve it.

care.choosePatientFirst: First choose the person you are helping.
care.noBookingPermission: You do not have permission to book for this person.
care.noViewPermission: You do not have permission to see this person's appointments.
care.intro: People you allow to help with your appointments. You decide what each person can do, and you can remove access at any time.
care.none: Nobody has asked to help you yet.
care.consentText: {{name}} will be able to do only what you tick below. Each time they use this access, it is recorded.
care.revokeExplain: They will stop seeing your appointments straight away. Appointments already booked stay as they are.
care.auditNote: Every approval, change and removal is recorded with its date.
care.noPatients: Nobody has approved you as a caregiver yet.
care.currentlyActing: You are acting for this person now.
care.requestExplain: Enter the patient's registered phone number or email. They will see your request and decide. For privacy, this screen does not say whether an account exists.
care.requestSent: If that account exists, the request has been sent.

permission.VIEW_PRECONSULTATION_INFORMATION: See answers given before the visit

notice.inAppOnly: Notifications appear only inside this app. No SMS or email is sent.
notice.APPOINTMENT_REMINDER: Reminder: {{patient_name}} has an appointment with {{doctor_name}} at {{hospital_name}}, {{when}}.
notice.CARE_REQUEST: {{caregiver_name}} has asked to help with your appointments.
notice.CARE_MODIFIED: {{patient_name}} has changed what you are allowed to do.
notice.WAITLIST_OFFER: A time has opened for {{patient_name}} with {{doctor_name}}: {{when}}. The offer is held until {{expires}}.

settings.accessNotes: Anything that helps us help you (optional)
settings.accessNotesHint: For example: needs large text, hard of hearing. Do not enter real health details in this demonstration.
settings.passwordChanged: Your password has been changed. Other devices have been signed out.
settings.noReset: Forgotten-password reset by email or SMS is not part of this demonstration.

doctor.title: Appointments
doctor.patientReported: Patient-reported, in the patient's own words. Not verified.
doctor.summaryNote: Generated by an AI model from the answers above and reviewed by the patient. Check against the answers before relying on it.
doctor.followUpVisible: The patient, and caregivers the patient has allowed, can read this.

admin.noHospital: This account is not linked to a hospital.
admin.addDoctorNote: Synthetic doctors only. Credentials are not verified by this system.
admin.doctorAdded: The doctor has been added. Add weekly hours under Schedules.
admin.initialPasswordHint: Needed only when the doctor has no account yet.
admin.generate: Create times for the next 14 days
admin.noClinical: Administrators see booking details only. Reasons for visits, answers, summaries and notes are not shown.

discover.subtitle: Use your location to find simulated CareBridge hospitals and database doctors.
discover.locationHelp: Map and geocoding services depend on OpenStreetMap. Hospital results come from CareBridge.
discover.locationNotFound: That location could not be found.
discover.noHospitals: No hospitals are near this location.
discover.noDoctors: No doctors match this hospital and specialty.
